newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 21.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia, now on a visit to Saudi Arabia, has said that the ruling Awami League was conspiring to eliminate her Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) and establish a one-party rule in the country.
The government is seriously considering integrating the country's communication network with rest of the world, Minister for Communication Anwar Hossain Manju said.
A South Korean firm, Youngone Corporation, was given go-ahead by the government on Saturday to set up an exclusive Export Processing Zone (EPZ) in Chittagong.
The National Committee, formed by the government to resolve insurgency problem in Chittagong hill districts, has said it is awaiting proposals from Shanti Bahini insurgents to initiate dialogue.
The government has formed an inter-ministreal committee to monitor smooth implementation of the power sector reform programme.
The Chittagong Stock Exchange (CSE) has become a member of the Istanbul-based Federation of Euro-Asian Stock Exchanges (FEAS).
